Hi Aisha —

Thanks — Ethan pulled together quick answers below and I’ve attached a one-page summary for your security team. Short answers:

- Retention: by default we cache embeddings for 30 days; we offer configurable retention windows per-customer down to 0 days for sensitive use cases. Rachel included the configuration steps in the attached summary.
- SSO: we support SAML 2.0 with IdP metadata exchange and SCIM for provisioning in Dedicated; Ethan can share an integration checklist if you want to kick off SSO prep.

If helpful, I’m happy to schedule the 30-min call with Ethan to walk your team through the controls and the SSO checklist. Proposed times: Tue 12/29 10am PT or Wed 12/30 9am PT. What works best?
